Hi Logan,

Thanks again for the demo last week — the team at Kestrel is excited to move forward. Attached is a small sample NDJSON dump (kestrel_index_sample.ndjson) that represents ~1% of our index. Before we scope the backfill, I want to confirm the approach and acceptance criteria for the rerank integration.

High-level asks from our side:
- We want a staggered priming (seed) rollout: small initial wave -> medium wave -> full backfill.
- Define clear rerank acceptance metrics (top-1 precision lift, MRR, and P95 latency impact).
- We need a short smoke-test window after each wave (48–72 hours) with rollback criteria.

Can your team propose thresholds & a tentative schedule? Also, we have compliance questions around index ingest logs (retention window) — I can loop in security if needed.

Thanks,

Thanks Olivia — this is perfect. Attaching a working mutual action plan (mutual_action_plan.xlsx) with an initial timeline. A few early commitments from our side:

- We'll run a 3-wave priming sequence (wave sizes: 1%, 10%, 100% of production index). Each wave includes a pre-window sample verification and a 72-hour smoke period.
- Suggested acceptance thresholds (draft): Top-1 precision delta >= +6% vs current heuristics, MRR uplift >= +4%, and end-to-end query P95 latency increase <= +25ms.
- Rollback criteria: if top-1 delta < +2% or MRR negative, automated rollback to current ranker.

Cc'ing Camila and Karthik to confirm resource needs for the backfill and to propose the technical gating checklist. We'll also add a short audit checklist to capture retention & logging questions.

Next steps: Camila — can you review the DB/shard implications? Karthik — can you draft the rerank smoke test harness and eval template (rerank_eval_template.csv)? Olivia — would Monday 6/22 for a kickoff call work for you?

On Tue, 15 Jun 2026 at 10:03, Logan Wright wrote:
> Thanks Olivia — this is perfect. Attaching a working mutual action plan ...

Quick technical notes from the serving + infra side:

1) Vector DB & sharding
- If Kestrel will use an external vector DB (Milvus/FAISS on their infra), we recommend wave 1 use our hosted nearest-neighbor service with a read-replica pattern to validate scores. Wave 2 should test the customer's DB in parallel (grey-route) for parity.
- For a 100% backfill we need a shard-friendly backfill script — we can provide a map-reduce style loader that uploads in parallel per-shard. Expect ~12–18 hours for a 10M vector backfill on 8 worker nodes (estimate; depends on vector dim and quantization).

2) Quantization & model variant tradeoffs
- Suggest trying INT8 quantized embeddings for the safety wave (wave 2 candidate) to reduce IO and storage. We'll record any quality delta in the eval template.

3) Eval & sampling
- Sampling: derive a stratified sample by user-intent buckets and document popularity (we want tail docs represented). For smoke, 5k queries / wave with ground-truth labels is a reasonable start.

I uploaded a short tech digest to the Drive (see link). I'll include the backfill script and a stubbed runner to collect per-query latency + rerank-score diffs.

— Camila
Staff DPE, Redwood Inference

Thanks — adding the rerank acceptance / smoke test checklist here (draft):

- Goals (per wave):
  * Top-1 precision lift >= +6% (relative to current production baseline)
  * MRR lift >= +4%
  * CTR on organic queries non-regressive
  * 72-hour smoke window with continuous monitoring; human review if any metric drops > 20% from baseline

- Test harness & metrics:
  * Use rerank_eval_template.csv for labeled queries; run A/B where 10% traffic to new stack during wave 2 for parity checks
  * Record per-query latency, model score, rerank delta, and user event conversion when available

- Rollback and escalation:
  * Automatic rollback if top-1 precision < +2% or MRR decreases vs baseline for the smoke window
  * Escalation to CS + engineering if latency P95 increases by >50ms

Monica — can you schedule the kickoff and own the mutual action plan milestones? I'll finalize the eval template and push a preliminary run today.

— Karthik
Onboarding Engineer, Redwood Inference
